more_info.overview: Natamycin is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include ripened cheese, cheese products (excluding products falling in category 16), non-heat-treated processed meat, heat-treated meat products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Produced by fermentation with Streptomyces natalensis or other suitable Streptomyces species. The active material is a polyene macrolide antifungal compound.
